propositions: Current clarity scoring rewards volume and legacy type-specific shape rather than enforcing the author-guide contract for required sections (Context, Problem, Approach, Scope, AC) keyed on graph altitude.
Clarity checks are duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py without unified schema, risking divergent behavior as criteria are extended.
Deterministic verification cannot distinguish placeholder language (TBD, figure out, depends on investigation) from concrete content in Scope/Approach, allowing deferred decisions to pass.
AC checkbox items lack consistent proof-linking requirements; coverage is not measured or reported against explicit proving/check clauses or operator attestation.

Documentation conflicts exist between author guides requiring rejected-alternative prose and authoritative G6 criteria forbidding it, and between Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria heading usage.
